There are 60 minutes in an hour.

Regarding the competitor analysis: Streamline Autos' direct-to-consumer (DTC) model for electric vehicles poses a significant strategic threat. By eliminating dealership markups, they can undercut traditional pricing, which may erode our market share if we remain reliant on high-margin dealership networks. Furthermore, their direct engagement allows for real-time data collection on consumer preferences, enabling faster product iteration and more targeted marketing. To mitigate this, we should consider accelerating our own digital sales initiatives, enhancing our online customer experience, and potentially exploring hybrid models that retain dealership benefits while leveraging direct data insights. Failure to adapt could result in losing price-sensitive and tech-savvy customers to Streamline Autos.
